titulo_fr: Un mode d'emploi : Repérer les informations
intro: It orders steps and conditions to use a device safely. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It orders steps and conditions to use a device safely. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention: The imperative gives direct instructions; « avant de » and « après avoir » order actions. In this fragment, «brancher» means «conectar».

frases.fr: Avant de brancher l'appareil, vérifiez que le réservoir d'eau est correctement installé.
frases.es: Antes de conectar el aparato, compruebe que el depósito de agua está bien colocado.
frases.en: Before connecting the device, check that the water tank is well placed.

frases.fr: Appuyez sur le bouton principal et attendez que le voyant vert s'allume.
frases.es: Pulse el botón principal y espere a que se encienda el indicador verde.
frases.en: Press the main button and wait for the green indicator to turn on.
